claims: The UEFA Champions League second leg between Sporting CP and Bodø/Glimt was on March 17, 2026.
Sporting CP defeated Bodø/Glimt 5-0 in the second leg.
Sporting CP brought back suspended key players Maxi Araújo and Pedro Gonçalves to start.
Sporting CP's goalkeeper was Rui Silva.
Sporting CP's defenders were Iván Fresneda, Eduardo Quaresma, Gonçalo Inácio, Maxi Araújo.
Sporting CP's midfielders were Morten Hjulmand, Hidemasa Morita.
Sporting CP's forwards were Geny Catamo, Pedro Gonçalves ("Pote"), Francisco Trincão, Luis Suárez.
Bodø/Glimt's defenders were Fredrik Sjøvold, Odin Lurås Bjørtuft, Jostein Gundersen, Fredrik André Bjørkan.
Bodø/Glimt's midfielders were Sondre Brunstad Fet, Patrick Berg, Håkon Evjen.
Bodø/Glimt's forwards were Ole Didrik Blomberg, Kasper Waarts Høgh, Jens Petter Hauge.
Eduardo Quaresma started in place of Ousmane Diomande for Sporting CP.
Pedro Gonçalves returned to the starting lineup for Sporting CP.
Bodø/Glimt maintained an unchanged lineup from the first leg.
